newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE wheat rises further in heavy volume on drought.
newsitem.headline: SFE wheat rises further in heavy volume on drought.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) wheat futures rose further on Thursday on deepening drought concern.
January 1998 rose by A$4.00 to A$201.00 on heavy volume, with 66 lots traded.
Settlement prices rose across the board, mostly by about A$4.00 a tonne, to well above the A$200.00 mark for almost all contracts.
January 1998 also attracted put option interest, with three lots of A$185.00 selling at A$6.50, one lot of A$195.00 selling at A$10.00 and five lots of A$200.00 selling at A$10.10.
